Callout.Name: Protection - Witness Address
Callout.Message: Threats made against a protected witness at a safe address.
Callout.Advisory: Witness inside, no damage visible to the property.

Script.Line: Somebody was outside again this morning. I did not answer the door.
I have done everything I was told. I do not go out.
How long am I supposed to live like this?

Lines.Briefing: Keep them alive and keep them calm, in that order.
Lines.Approach: Somebody has been past the address twice this morning and the witness does not know.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
